descriptionChirho: Personal pronoun referring to a third-person entity (he, him, his, she, her, it, its, they, them, their) in all cases, genders, and numbers.
Emphatic or intensive use meaning 'himself, herself, itself, themselves, myself,' highlighting the identity or agency of the subject.
Predicate or attributive use with the article meaning 'the same, the very same, identical,' indicating sameness or continuity.
